## Checklist

- [ ] The target branch is right: `camertrace` for Cameroon-only work (`cm/*`); generic work (`feat/*`, `fix/*`) starts from `main` (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Lint, tests, and build pass locally.
- [ ] No secrets, and no real personal data (farmer cards, phone numbers, e-mails, coordinates).
- [ ] Brand values (names, colours, logos) are only in the brand layer; status colours are unchanged.
- [ ] For `feat/*` / `fix/*`: `scripts/check-upstream-clean.sh <branch>` passes.
- [ ] New user-visible text is translated (at least English and French).
